trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ وَجَّهْتُ اِلَيْهِ وَجْهِيْ يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ شَكَوْتُ اِلَيْهِ وَحْدَتِيْ يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ شَخَصْتُ اِلَيْهِ بِبَصَرِيْ يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ نَاجَيْتُهٗ فِيْ سِرِّيْ وَيَا خَيْرَ مَنْ بَسَطْتُ‌اِلَيْهِ يَدِيْ يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ رَجَوْتُهٗ فِيْ حَاجَتِيْ يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ فَكَّرْتُ فِيْهِ بِقَلْبِيْ۔

lines.rarabic: YAA KHAIRA MAN WAJJAH-TO ILAIY-HE WAJHEE YAA KHAIRA MAN SHA-KAWTO ILAIY-HE WAHDA-TEE YAA KHAIRA MAN SHA-KHASTO ILAIY-HE BE-BASA-REE YAA KHAIRA MAN NAA-JAIY-TO-HU FEE SIRREE WA YAA KHAIRA MAN BASAT-TO ILAIY-HE YADEE YAA KHAIRA MAN RAJAW-TOHU FEE HAAJA-TEE YAA KHAIRA MAN FAK-KARTO FEEHE BE-QALBEE.

trans.en: O the best to whom I turn my face! O the best to whom I complain about my loneliness! O the best at whom I stare! O the best to whom I express my secrets! O the best towards whom I extend my hand! O the best in whom I hope for my needs! O the best about whom I think! O the best to whom I point with my hands!
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ اَشَرْتُ اِلَيْهِ بِكَفِّي اجْعَلْ اَفْضَلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ عَلٰى اَفْضَلِ خَلْقِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهٖ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ وَاجْعَلْهُمْ وَاِيَّانَا وَمَا تَفَضَّلْتَ بِهٖ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلَيْنَا فِيْ كَنَفِكَ وَحِرْزِكَ وَكِفَايَتِكَ وَكِلَاءَتِكَ وَسِتْرِكَ الْوَاقِيْ مِنْ كُلِّ سُوْءٍ وَمَخُوْفٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ فَاِنَّا قَدِ اسْتَغْنَيْنَا وَاعْتَصَمْنَا وَتَعَزَّزْنَا بِكَ وَاَنْتَ الْغَالِبُ غَيْرُ مَغْلُوْبٍ (الْمَغْلُوْبِ)۔

lines.rarabic: YAA KHAIRA MAN A-SHAR-TO ILAIY-HE BE-KAFFIJ A’L AFZALA SALA-WAATE-KA A’LAA AF-ZALE KHALQE-KA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE A’LAIY-HE WA A’LAIY-HE-MUS SALAAMO WAJ-A’L-HUM WA IYYAA-NAA WA MAA TA-FAZ-ZALTA BEHI A’LAIY-HIM WA A’LAIY-NAA FEE KANA-FEKA WA HAR-ZEKA WA KEFAA-YATE-KA WA KELAA-ATE-KA WA SITRE-KAL WAAQEE MIN KULLE SOO-IN WA MA-KHOO-FIN FID-DUNYAA WAL AA-KHE-RATE FA-INNAA QADIS TAGH-NAIY-NAA WA’TASAM-NAA WA TA-A’Z-ZAZ-NAA BEKA WA ANTAL GHAALE-BO GHAIY-RO MAGH-LOO-BEEN (AL-MAGH-LOOBE).

trans.en: Let the best of Your Blessings be upon Your noblest creature Muhammad and his Progeny. Please cover them and us and what You favored them and us with under Your Protection, Your Sufficiency, Your Guard, and Your Protecting Cover from all evils and fears in this world and the Hereafter. We are enriched by You and we have sought Your Protection and are honored by You. You are the Undefeatable Winner.

arabic.text: وَرَمَيْنَا كُلَّ مَنْ اَرَادَ اَهْلَ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَشْيَاعَهُمْ وَاَحِبَّاءَهُمْ بِسُوْءٍ اَوْ بِخَوْفٍ اَوْ بِاَذًى بِلَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الْحَلِيْمُ الْعَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ وَبِلَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ وَبِلَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا فِيْهِنَّ وَرَبِّ الْاَرَضِيْنَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا فِيْهِنَّ وَمَا بَيْنَهُنَّ وَرَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ۔

lines.rarabic: WA RAMAIY-NAA KULLA MAN A-RAADA AHLA BAIY-TE MOHAMMADIN WA ASHYAA-A’HUM WA A-HIBBAA-A-HUM BE-SOO-IN AW BE-KHAW-FIN AW BE-A-ZAN BE-LAA ILAAHA ILLAL-LAAHUL HALEE-MUL A’LEEMUL KAREEMO WA BE-LAA ILAAHA ILLAL-LAAHUL A’LIYYUL A’ZEEMO WA BE-LAA ILAAHA ILLAL-LAAHO RABBIS SAMAA-WAATIS SAB-E’ WA MAA FEE-HINNA WA RABBIL ARA-ZEE-NAS SAB-E’ WA MAA FEE-HINNA WA MAA BAIY-NA-HUNNA WA RABBIL A’R-SHIL A’ZEEME.

trans.en: We throw the ideological spear of There is no God but God the Forbearing, the Generous! There is no God but God the Sublime, the Supreme. There is no God but God Lord of the seven Heavens and whatever is in between them! Lord of the seven earths and whatever is in between them! And Lord of the Throne Supreme! to whoever tries to bother, frighten or hurt the Progeny of Muhammad, or their followers and adherents.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
